sections.heading: Baby Keepsake & Memory Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Baby Keepsake & Memory Box FAQ What can a baby keepsake box hold? Whatever your set includes: a folded outfit or blanket, small shoes, cards, photos and small keepsakes. We lay out compartments and drawers from your item list and check the layout on a 3D mock-up before the sample. Book-style or lift-off lid? A book-style box with magnetic closure opens like a cover and suits a memory box with drawers. A lift-off lid and base is simpler and suits gift packaging for clothing or a blanket. Both are made as rigid boxes. Can each box carry a baby's name? The box is made in batches with your brand design. A space on the cover can take a name label that you or your customer add after production. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you supply the clothes or blankets? No. We make the box and inserts; the contents come from your own products.

A baby keepsake box is the box parents keep: first outfit, knitted shoes, a blanket, cards and photos, stored in one rigid box that opens like a book or lifts off like a gift box. Babywear and children's brands use it as their gift packaging, and gift companies sell it as a memory box with compartments and small drawers already laid out.
